Case note: CS(COMM) 737/2019
Client: Aarti Pai (architect, Jaipur)
Opposing party: Meridian Airways Ltd
Court: Rajasthan High Court, before Justice Arvind Bhargava
Filed on: 18 November 2019
Claim amount: Rs. 34,82,00,000
Issue: aircraft lease repossession. The airline has stopped paying lease rentals.
Advice given: Seek deregistration of the aircraft under the international lease convention.
Outcome: The aviation regulator deregistered the aircraft.
Recommended next step: Arrange the export of the aircraft.
Matter code: Project Ibis
